description:
FILED s543 (the reviewing session, 2026-11-22), after the USER saw s543h wait on one leg for most of an hour and called it hung.  It was not hung; the queue starved it, and then the leg died of an agent mistake.

MEASURED (the START / END lines of the three batches` legs, `~/pcl-agent-scratch/s513/HEAVY.queue`):
  16:30:12  s543h queues its exclusive `bench` leg.
  16:29:51  a bounded leg of s543g had taken slot 1 (it ended about 17:00).
  16:32:16 16:32:31 16:41:32 16:51:03 16:53:42 16:55:46  SIX more bounded legs of s543g / s543i START in slots 2-4 while the exclusive leg waits.
  17:06:14  the exclusive leg gets the box (36 minutes) -- and ends at once: `bench.sh: Permission denied`, rc=126 (the script was not executable).
  17:06:46  re-queued; 17:12:45 s543g`s own exclusive leg goes first; 17:14:19 s543h`s bench starts and runs.

CAUSE (`~/pcl-agent-scratch/s513/heavy.sh`, the four-slot script = `heavy.sh.four-slot-s542`; the three-slot one has the same shape): an exclusive leg does `flock -w 8` (slot 1) FIRST and writes `HEAVY.exclusive-waiting` only when it HOLDS slot 1.  Until then `excl_waiting` is false for everybody, so bounded legs go on taking slots 2-4; and slot 1 itself is taken by a bounded leg with an unconditional `flock -n 8`.  With two batches the window was short; with three batches and a 25-minute sweep in slot 1 it is the whole sweep.

FIX SHAPE (not applied: the script must never be edited in place while legs run -- bash reads a running script incrementally; write a new file and `mv` it): (1) the exclusive leg writes its marker BEFORE it waits for slot 1 (a marker per waiter, `HEAVY.exclusive-waiting.PID`, since two exclusive legs can wait at once; `excl_waiting` = any marker whose pid is alive); (2) a bounded leg asks `excl_waiting` before slot 1 too; (3) the queue line of an exclusive leg says how many bounded legs are running, so its batch can see why it waits.  TEST before use: two fake batches with `sleep` legs, an exclusive leg queued behind a long slot-1 holder -- no bounded leg may START after the exclusive one queued.

SECOND HALF (agents, not the script): a leg script must be executable BEFORE it is queued -- 36 minutes of queue were spent to learn `Permission denied`.  heavy.sh can check `-x "$1"` (or run a non-executable `*.sh` through bash) at QUEUE time and refuse with exit 2 at once.  The briefs` heavy-leg paragraph gets the sentence.

THIRD (the reviewing session): an agent`s interim notice `waiting on its own background work` says nothing about HOW LONG the leg has waited.  A reviewing session that gets the third such notice in a row for the same batch looks at `HEAVY.queue` (the leg`s `waiting since` time) and at the newest log`s last line -- one command -- and tells the USER what it found.

=== CLOSED at 2026-11-22 evening (the reviewing session): a tooling agent (Opus 5.5) wrote `~/pcl-agent-scratch/s513/heavy.sh.four-slot-s543` with the fix shape above -- the marker `HEAVY.exclusive-waiting.PID` goes up BEFORE slot 1 (the old single file is still honoured), a bounded leg asks before slot 1 too, the queue line of an exclusive leg says `[bounded legs running: N]`, a CMD file that is not executable is refused at queue time with exit 2 -- plus one change beyond it: each `flock` of an exclusive waiter runs in the background (`flock ... & wait`), because bash holds a trap back until a foreground command ends and a killed waiter would have kept a live marker for up to 60 minutes.  TEST `~/pcl-agent-scratch/s543/tooling-5191/test-heavy.sh` (its own HEAVY_DIR, sleep legs, 35 checks, four runs in a row; the s542 script shows the bug: bounded legs start at +2 s and +7 s before the exclusive one at +12 s).  INSTALLED by rename at ~19:52 with three bounded legs running and none waiting; a marker line in HEAVY.queue.  COMMON.md HEAVY SLOTS (1) has the chmod sentence.  LEFT (not filed, noted in DECIDED): killing heavy.sh itself leaves its command running with the slots freed; a kill -9 leaves a stale HEAVY.holder.N; the header still says THREE slots in one line; the three-slot script was not changed.
subject: TOOLING: heavy.sh STARVES an exclusive leg while a bounded leg holds slot 1 -- the exclusive-waiting marker is written only AFTER slot 1 is taken, so the other slots keep filling (s543h bench: queued 16:30, started 17:06, with three batches on four slots)
triage_reason: the heavy-leg queue of the agent box, not the compiler
